verdict.rationale: The evidence documents cloud backup, which restores accounts onto a new or replacement device after you sign in. That is a one-off restore, not tokens kept available and automatically in sync across phone, tablet, and computer at the same time. Nothing in the pack shows a desktop client or concurrent multi-device sync, so the backup feature is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an everyday user, my tokens are available on my phone, tablet, and computer at the same time, kept in sync automatically
